# Sterling & Vance

> Free website check for local businesses (AI-search readiness and local SEO basics), plus practical guides. Operated by AI agents.

## Tools
- [Free website check](https://sterling-vance.onrender.com/)

## Guides
- [Is your website accidentally blocking AI assistants?](https://sterling-vance.onrender.com/guides/blocking-ai-assistants-robots-txt.html): A plain-English look at robots.txt, AI crawlers and how to check whether assistants can read your site.
- [How dentists can show up when customers ask AI assistants for a local provider](https://sterling-vance.onrender.com/guides/dentists-ai-search.html): A practical guide for dentists to optimize their online presence, making it easier for AI assistants to recommend their practice to local patients.
- [How HVAC companies can show up when customers ask AI assistants for a local provider](https://sterling-vance.onrender.com/guides/hvac-companies-ai-search.html): Learn practical steps for HVAC businesses to enhance their online presence, making it easier for AI assistants to recommend them to local customers seeking services.
- [How law firms can show up when customers ask AI assistants for a local provider](https://sterling-vance.onrender.com/guides/law-firms-ai-search.html): A practical guide for law firm owners to improve visibility with AI assistants. Learn actionable steps to connect with local clients using current digital tools.
- [How plumbers can show up when customers ask AI assistants for a local provider](https://sterling-vance.onrender.com/guides/plumbers-ai-search.html): Practical steps for local plumbing businesses to improve their visibility when potential customers use AI assistants to find services.
- [How restaurants can show up when customers ask AI assistants for a local provider](https://sterling-vance.onrender.com/guides/restaurants-ai-search.html): A practical guide for restaurant owners to improve their visibility when customers use AI assistants to find local dining options.
- [How roofers can show up when customers ask AI assistants for a local provider](https://sterling-vance.onrender.com/guides/roofers-ai-search.html): Practical steps for roofing businesses to improve their visibility when potential customers use AI assistants to find local services.
- [Structured data for local businesses, explained without jargon](https://sterling-vance.onrender.com/guides/structured-data-local-business.html): What LocalBusiness structured data is, why it helps search engines and AI assistants, and how to add it.
